description: Cases for the `$` metadata suffixes, which the runner resolves while walking a reference path and the editor's simulator resolves the same way. Metadata is computed from whatever the path lands on, so it works at any depth, not only on a top-level variable. A `$` segment is accepted only as the last segment of a reference: a value can genuinely hold a key named `$length`, and refusing it in the middle keeps one meaning for `$`.
